acceptance_criteria: Only the exact provider-published 2023, 2024, and 2025 roster assets and their verified SHA-256 digests enter the acquisition identity.
Every normalized row retains immutable source-asset, source-row, row-hash, season, team, and player evidence; draft fields observed in 2025 remain excluded from the roster candidate.
Canonical-person and membership candidates require exact source-ID, normalized-name, and canonical-membership agreement; conflicts remain quarantined and source-only rows are not promoted.

Roster membership does not imply historical availability, source release timestamps do not become game-time known-at evidence, and no canonical, PIT, feature, training, protected, or production admission is granted.
An independent validator and isolated deterministic rebuild reproduce the exact population, dispositions, payload hashes, dataset identity, and manifest identity.
ai_context_notes: CFBD remained the preferred authenticated route, but bounded retries returned HTTP 429; the exact equivalent public SportsDataverse release assets were acquired without pausing the domain.
No OpenAI output or inferred factual value is admitted into the roster artifacts.
This is a candidate-only roster-domain expansion checkpoint; historical acquisition for plays, drives, gamebooks, and other gaps remains independently active.
definition_of_done: The exact 2023-2025 national roster assets are immutable, content-addressed, digest-verified, and stored outside Git.
All 79,832 source rows are normalized and conservatively reconciled with exact reason-coded dispositions and 749 conflict rows quarantined.
The independent 17-check validator and five-payload deterministic rebuild pass with zero mismatches.
The historical recovery contract, replay gate, Jira evidence, and governing-goal checkpoint record the exact identities, limitations, and protected nonclaims.
Historical expansion continues to the next useful nonduplicate domains without treating this partial roster tranche as final population readiness.
end_to_end_validation: Rebuild the complete candidate and quarantine payloads in an isolated external root; verify provider digests, acquisition identity, row lineage, exact population and disposition counts, authority boundaries, payload hashes, manifest identity, and cleanup of the rebuild root.
in_scope: National 2023-2025 player-team-season roster membership from exact digest-pinned release assets.
Provider-route fallback, immutable acquisition, schema inspection, Unicode-aware normalization, conservative identity reconciliation, quarantine, missingness, provenance, and deterministic replay.
Candidate-only evidence that can support later identity and roster-domain review after independent known-at and PIT qualification.
objective: Close the post-2022 roster acquisition gap with immutable national source captures, conservative reconciliation, exact quarantine, and coverage gating while preserving historical-known-at and protected-promotion boundaries.
out_of_scope: Treating source release timestamps as historical game-time known-at evidence or roster membership as availability.
Name-only person merges, fabricated fields, inferred missing values, or automatic canonical/PIT/feature/training admission.
Final historical-population readiness, GAP-002 resolution, protected evaluation, champion promotion, production readiness, A&M specialization lift, BAS, or Aggie Excess.
prerequisites: Validated canonical people and membership registries with pinned hashes.
Configured external data root and immutable raw snapshot contract.
Provider-published release metadata and SHA-256 asset digests for all three seasons.
required_evidence: Exact provider release, asset, acquisition, manifest, dataset, registry, payload, and validation identities.
Season rows, bytes, schema drift, disposition counts, quarantine counts, missingness, and excluded future/draft fields.
Credential-safe request behavior, bounded-route failure evidence, equivalent-route acquisition, deterministic rebuild, and cleanup.
Explicit candidate-only authority, historical-known-at limitations, and protected nonclaims.

required_tests.expectation: Credential redaction, deterministic request identities, schema inspection, conservative roster reconciliation, conflicts, and source-only nonpromotion pass.
External candidate, quarantine, and manifest payloads pass all 17 independent checks and a byte-identical isolated deterministic rebuild.

risk_failure_conditions: Any provider digest, acquisition identity, canonical-registry identity, row lineage, population, disposition, payload hash, or deterministic rebuild drifts.
Any name-only, conflicting, or source-only identity is silently promoted.
Any post-season release timestamp, draft field, roster membership, or missing fact is misrepresented as historical known-at availability.
Any candidate roster artifact is treated as protected or production authority.
scope: Acquire and validate the missing national 2023-2025 roster tranche, preserve exact external captures and lineage, reconcile only evidence-supported identities, and quarantine every conflict without blocking unrelated historical domains.
stop_conditions: Stop the affected artifact on source digest, identity, population, lineage, schema, quarantine, authority, or deterministic rebuild failure.
If one provider route is technically unavailable, use an equivalent permitted public route and preserve the route decision; do not pause unrelated acquisition.
Do not open protected promotion until the expanded quality-supported historical-known-at population and applicable W17 gates pass.
title: [POST-SUBTASK-173] Acquire, reconcile, and coverage-gate post-2022 national rosters
why_this_exists: The validated roster source population stopped at 2022 even though the broader historical-expansion contract requires every useful domain to be acquired and coverage-gated independently by season without imposing a four-season ceiling.
